0022600110.text: The Pelicans, 0-1 and ninth in the West, visit the Nuggets for their third game of the season, while Denver is also 0-1 and has yet to play at home this year. Denver is without Cameron Johnson (out, ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring), and Alpha Diallo is day-to-day with a wrist injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pelicans lost 0-3 to Denver in 2025-26, most recently 122-116 in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
